steps.en: Install EasyOCR and select the languages to recognize
steps.zh: 安装 EasyOCR，选择要识别的语言

steps.en: Create one Reader for those languages
steps.zh: 为这些语言创建一个 Reader

steps.en: Selects and downloads the matching model weights
steps.zh: 选择并下载对应的模型权重

steps.en: Pass an image to the loaded reader
steps.zh: 把图像交给已加载的 reader

steps.en: Detects text, recognizes each region, and returns boxes, text, and confidence
steps.zh: 检测文字，识别各区域，返回边界框、文字和置信度

value.en: One Python call turns an image into localized text results across the selected scripts
value.zh: 一次 Python 调用把图像变成所选 script 的定位文字结果
